digest.component_or_area: Jira adapters (Cloud and Data Center reconcilers)
propositions: Cloud adapter (ACLI-based) and Data Center adapter (pycontribs-based) lack symmetric test coverage of shared behaviors, with Cloud missing multi-page pagination and rate-limiting edge cases while DC lacks value-level characterization pins

DC adapter's create-path field values, sanitizer boundaries, identity labels, and probe branches are untested by value (contract tests assert shape only), leaving defect detection dependent solely on live harness configuration
Duplicate ticket-type map literal exists in multiple locations within adapters/, creating maintenance burden and risk of divergence between Cloud and DC paths

DC comment and description field length convergence behavior lacks test coverage across multiple passes, and the length limit constant lacks provenance documentation linking to Jira configuration properties
Vacuous tests exist that assert nothing meaningful about adapter behavior, providing false confidence in test coverage
Cloud whole-project pagination and DC TLS/credential validation are asymmetric capabilities requiring different expected values in parametrized test cases rather than assertions of sameness
